response.original_title: Put A Smile On For Me
response.overview: Keo's debut album 'Put A Smile On For Me' is a raw, emotionally exposed record from one of the UK's most vital new guitar bands. The album captures the fallout of love, guilt and self-destruction across 11 volatile tracks including the explosive single 'That's Me'. Following sold-out tours and breakout festival appearances, 'Put A Smile On For Me' captures Keo at the exact moment underground obsession turns into something much bigger, and captures one of the UK's most exciting new alternative bands at a pivotal moment.
response.title: Put A Smile On For Me
